dripzoid.description: Online clothing shopping platform offering curated streetwear, everyday essentials, and seasonal apparel collections.
dripzoid.tone: Friendly, stylish, clear, and helpful customer-support specialist

policies.shipping_and_delivery: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days across India. Express delivery takes 1-2 business days in metro cities for an extra INR 149. Orders above INR 1,499 qualify for free standard shipping.
policies.returns_and_exchanges: Unworn items with original tags can be returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery. Customized or clearance items are final sale.
policies.order_tracking: Customers receive an order ID and tracking link via email and SMS once the order ships within 24 hours of confirmation.
policies.payment_methods: Accepted payment methods are UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for orders up to INR 5,000.

knowledge_base.support_hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST

edusmart.description: Career-focused online learning academy offering cohort-based courses, coding bootcamps, and certification guidance for college students and working professionals.
edusmart.tone: Encouraging, structured, academic, and concise student advisor

catalog.prerequisites: Basic programming logic; no prior AI experience required

policies.enrollment: Students enroll online by selecting a cohort start date and completing registration payment. Seats are confirmed immediately upon payment.
policies.refund_policy: A 100% refund is available within 7 days of cohort start if less than 20% of course content has been accessed.
policies.certification: Verified digital certificates are issued after completing 80% attendance and passing the capstone project review.
policies.class_recordings: All live sessions are recorded and remain accessible on the student portal for 12 months.

knowledge_base.support_hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST
